text:
Sofia: Quick sync 8				) TitanCloud marketplace readiness + SI integration. We need to lock dates and tests.
Ravi: Titan's comms suggested an embargo week of May 10-14. Are we aligning with that or doing staggered?
Ellen: We wanted Redwood public GA on May 12, with marketplace tile live same day. If Titan wants earlier embargo it's fine as long as assets are ready.
Jae: Heads-up: SI integration run (partner SI) scheduled May 11 for smoke tests. That can't change; don't schedule press that conflicts.
PressOps: Proposed approach: embargo May 11 (partners only), public May 12 10:00am PT. That gives SI a day to validate before public. Need final press kit by Apr 28.
LegalBot: Legal needs co-announcement text + partner consent for quotes by Apr 25. Also requested trademark usage for Titan logos.
SIIntegrator: Integration checklist: 1) Marketplace SKU mapping 2) SSO config 3) Network allowlist 4) Billing test. Can we get SKU mapping by Apr 22?
Sofia: We'll assign SKU mapping to Ravi. Ravi, can you coordinate with Titan PM to map SKUs and provide sample billing events by Apr 20?
Ravi: Yep. I'll request the CSV mapping and sample payloads today. ETA 04/20.
Ellen: For the landing page: hero, short benefits, "Try on TitanCloud" CTA, and an iframe demo. Do we have legal-approved placeholder for data residency?
LegalBot: Use: "Data processed in regional TitanCloud zones; customer data residency options available." We'll finalize exact phrasing after Intel review.
PressOps: Localization note: request translations (EN/DE/FR/JP) for press snippet by Apr 30 if we want localized marketplace tiles at launch. Is that a hard requirement?
Sofia: Not mandatory for day 1, but high-value markets should have DE/FR. Let's aim for EN + DE for listing at launch.
SIIntegrator: Can the staging listing include a test license key so SIs can demo? We prefer a short-lived test key TTL 7 days.
Jae: Yes, staging supports ephemeral keys. Use testing keys and sandbox billing toggled off. I'll coordinate with infra.
DeployBot: Staging deploy successful  build 2026.04.01-3. Staging URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/titan-integration 
Ravi: I'll upload SKU mapping to the staging drive and share the link here once Titan sends it.
Ellen: Marketing assets checklist: partner logo (svg), partner brand color, partner headshot, short quote, extended quote, 300x250 tile image, and marketplace tile JSON.
Sofia: Can we see a sample marketplace tile JSON? Something small we can validate against marketplace schema.
SIIntegrator: Example snippet (staging only):
```json
{"sku":"rwd-titan-1","title":"Redwood Inference on TitanCloud","price":"contact","regions":["us-west-2","eu-central-1"],"plan_types":["dedicated","hosted_preview"]}
```
Ellen: Nice. We'll adapt that for the live tile.
PressOps: Press list: TechCrunch, The Register, VentureBeat, End-user newsletters. I'll draft embargo email once legal signs off.
LegalBot: Reminder: partner quote MUST include explicit permission for press/blog/social reuse. No implied consent.
Sofia: Owners and deadlines: Ravi (SKU mapping + billing samples) 04/20, Marco from Titan (quote + logo) 04/22, Ellen (landing + tile + assets) 04/28, Legal (sign-off) 04/25, SIIntegrator (integration smoke pass) 05/11, PressOps (embargo send) 05/10.
Ravi: Re-confirming: I'll get the CSV today.
Marco (Titan PM via DM): shared in thread: Titan can provide short & long quote and logos by 04/22.
Sofia: Thanks. Contingency: if Titan misses 04/22, we proceed with Redwood blog on May 12 and convert joint announcement to a follow-up post.
PressOps: Noted. I'll prepare a two-email cadence: joint and solo fallback.
Jae: For the SI run, please circulate runbook with test cases by 05/05. I'll need all staging credentials by then.
SIIntegrator: Will publish runbook in the shared drive and ping this thread.
Ellen: I'll upload preview copy and hero mock to staging by 04/27 for design + infra QA.
LegalBot: Once copy is uploaded, tag legal for review.
Sofia: Great progress. Final ask: everyone react with :white_check_mark: when you've confirmed your deliverable dates. We'll do a dry-run on 05/10 with pressOps and SI present.
PressOps: Adding dry-run to calendar for May 10 09:00am PT.
Sofia: Closing thread after deliverables are confirmed. Thanks all. :rocket:
